options.detail:
Also spelled -v. Use ./data or /path for an existing bind source, data for a named volume, or an absolute destination alone for an anonymous volume. Remote clients mount from the server. Append comma-separated options, as in ./data:/data:ro,z. The default is rw.

:z relabels source files for sharing between containers. :Z gives them a private SELinux label shared by containers in the same pod. Relabeling system directories can disrupt host services.

:O writes to a temporary overlay discarded after execution. Leave the lower directory untouched while running. Custom upperdir and workdir persist and require manual cleanup. O conflicts with other volume modes.

bind omits nested mounts and rbind includes them. On bind mounts private isolates new mounts, shared propagates both ways, slave propagates from host to container, and unbindable prevents rebinding. Prefix r for recursive propagation. The source mount must support the requested propagation.

copy seeds a new internal volume once from the container directory. nocopy skips it. dev/nodev, exec/noexec and suid/nosuid control devices, execution and set-ID bits. Podman documents nodev and nosuid as defaults. idmap maps file IDs into the target user namespace. A custom idmap accepts uids= or gids= ranges in START-TARGET-COUNT form.

Named volumes are created on demand. Upstream 6.2 adds nocreate to require an existing one. :U recursively changes ownership of host files to the mapped container UID and GID. Large trees can delay startup.
options.summary: Mount a host path or volume in the container

options.detail:
Alias for --volume. Use ./data or /path for an existing bind source, data for a named volume, or an absolute destination alone for an anonymous volume. Remote clients mount from the server. Append comma-separated options, as in ./data:/data:ro,z. The default is rw.

:z relabels source files for sharing between containers. :Z gives them a private SELinux label shared by containers in the same pod. Relabeling system directories can disrupt host services.

:O writes to a temporary overlay discarded after execution. Leave the lower directory untouched while running. Custom upperdir and workdir persist and require manual cleanup. O conflicts with other volume modes.

bind omits nested mounts and rbind includes them. On bind mounts private isolates new mounts, shared propagates both ways, slave propagates from host to container, and unbindable prevents rebinding. Prefix r for recursive propagation. The source mount must support the requested propagation.

copy seeds a new internal volume once from the container directory. nocopy skips it. dev/nodev, exec/noexec and suid/nosuid control devices, execution and set-ID bits. Podman documents nodev and nosuid as defaults. idmap maps file IDs into the target user namespace. A custom idmap accepts uids= or gids= ranges in START-TARGET-COUNT form.

Named volumes are created on demand. Upstream 6.2 adds nocreate to require an existing one. :U recursively changes ownership of host files to the mapped container UID and GID. Large trees can delay startup.
